findings.claim_text: Status as of 2026-10-03: Google has confirmed contact with the satellite, which is still being commissioned. No TPU data has been published [^1,9].
Independent models put orbit at 1.5–4.4x ground cost [^32,33].
findings.contradicting_quote: starts at more than 4x in 2026 before narrowing to parity in ~2040 ... with levelized costs of compute in space declining below terrestrial thereafter

findings.claim_text: The beam also logged soft errors, including 203 HBM uncorrectable-error events at about one per 44 rad. The paper extrapolates silent data corruption to about one per 3 million inferences at one inference per second [^5].
findings.contradicting_quote: The error rate is very low if you're thinking about typical inference operations, right? Like one in a million.
